Threshold objects: es_thresholds(), es_benchmarks(), mcid_thresholds(), mcid_distribution(); conversion to_plot_scale() pooled_sd(). plot_contrasts() TukeyHSD, emmeans contrasts data frames. chen_or_thresholds() computes Chen, Cohen & Chen (2010) odds-ratio equivalents d baseline risk. method protective harmful zones mirror images, zones 1 computed negative d (also es_benchmarks("chen_or")). es_thresholds() gains cuts_lower asymmetric effect-size zones. layers gain zone_labels rename zones (name). legend lists zones appear plot. plot_contrasts() accepts aov fits emmeans grids means directly, recovers model behind TukeyHSD object (verified contrasts). model’s residual SD used automatically one-way models; otherwise sd must given. geom_mcid_zones(beyond = "multiples") now requires point MCID thresholds; range MCID multiples uncertain , combination error. DOIs added cited references. plot_contrasts() choose SD d (models one term), error now explains rigorous procedure step step, refit command tailored plotted term. Package website: flatly theme, hex logo, new article, mathematics behind effectzones, step--step interactive calculators every calculation package performs.
